ch2_imaginary_seat.text: Your imaginary friend needs their own seat at the restaurant. The waiter is being very professional about it.

ch2_lose_tooth.text: Your first tooth is hanging by a thread, and you have been wiggling it for nine days. It finally comes off in an apple.

ch2_sleepover.text: {{name}} invites you to a sleepover. The plan is pizza, a movie, and staying up until at least nine.

outcomes.legend: You stay up until ten and eat cereal at dawn. It is the best night of your year.
outcomes.homesick: At midnight you get homesick and call home. {{name}} pretends not to notice.

ch2_picture_day.text: It is school picture day. Someone cut your bangs yesterday, and that someone was you.

ch2_lost_mall.text: You turn around and {{name}} is gone. There are only knees, shopping bags, and one very loud pretzel stand.

outcomes.found: You find {{name}} by the fountain, looking far more worried than you.
outcomes.longer: It takes twenty minutes and one announcement over the speakers with your full name.

ch2_talent_show.text: The school talent show has an open slot. Your act is a card trick you have practiced for a total of two minutes.

outcomes.wow: The trick works. The gym goes quiet, then loud, and a first grader asks for your autograph.
outcomes.fine: Half the cards end up on the floor. People clap anyway, mostly out of mercy.
outcomes.flop: The card you promised is not in the deck. You bow slowly and leave.

ch2_first_phone.text: {{name}} hands you your first phone and a list of rules that is longer than the phone's manual.

ch2_braces.text: The orthodontist says you need braces, and you will be expected to smile about it for two years.

ch2_learn_instrument.text: The school music teacher asks which instrument you want to try. Each one looks louder than the last.

outcomes.natural: You find the right notes by Friday. The neighbors learn to love it.
outcomes.squeak: It makes a sound like a goose in a hallway, but you keep at it.

ch2_sports_tryouts.text: Tryouts for the school team are on Thursday. You have never played, but you own the shoes.

outcomes.made: You make the team, probably because you ran the fastest away from the ball.
outcomes.cut: You get cut, but the coach says your sneakers had great spirit.

ch2_dog_walking.text: A neighbor pays you to walk their dog. The dog has opinions about squirrels, and so does the leash.

outcomes.great: Four weeks later you have forty dollars and a very tired dog.
outcomes.escape: The dog escapes into a hedge. You spend an hour retrieving him and your dignity.

ch2_learn_cook.text: {{name}} says it is time you learned to cook. Today's lesson is scrambled eggs, which are mostly patience.

ch2_sibling_rivalry.text: {{name}} is given the bigger half of the dessert, and a war of attrition begins at the table.

outcomes.works: You cut it carefully with a ruler. {{name}} is oddly impressed.
outcomes.crumbs: It crumbles into twelve pieces and nobody is happy.

ch2_elderly_relative.text: An elderly relative visits and pinches your cheek with a professional grip. Then they hand you something wrapped in a napkin.

ch2_pet_rock.text: You find a rock that is perfectly round and very sure of itself. You name it and bring it home.

ch2_science_kit.text: You get a chemistry set for your birthday. The instructions say to ask an adult, in a font that suggests they mean it.

outcomes.success: A small, tidy fizz. You write it in your notebook and feel like a professional.
outcomes.boom: The experiment pops and leaves a green stain on the ceiling. You have questions.

ch2_snow_day.text: A fresh snowfall cancels school, and the entire neighborhood is outside with a variety of sleds.

ch2_summer_camp.text: Your parents send you to summer camp. The brochure says friends for life, and the brochure has never met a mosquito.

ch2_scouts.text: The local scout troop is recruiting. The uniform has more badges than seems physically reasonable.

choices.visit: Visit once, see how it goes

ch2_bully_intro.text: A bigger kid keeps stealing your seat on the bus, and every day the seat feels smaller.

ch2_bully_peace.text: The kid who used to take your bus seat sits at your lunch table and says nothing. Then they offer half a sandwich.

ch2_fake_sick.text: You have a math test today and a stomachache that appeared at breakfast. {{name}} looks at you with a thermometer and suspicion.

outcomes.home: You get the day off. Cartoons are fine, but the test is still waiting on Monday.
outcomes.caught: The thermometer says 36 degrees. {{name}} drives you to school in meaningful silence.

ch2_report_card.text: Report card day. The grades are fine, mostly, with the exception of one teacher's comment that you 'talk during silence'.

ch2_first_concert.text: {{name}} has two tickets to a concert and an extra pair of ear plugs. Everyone says it will be loud.

outcomes.magic: You scream the chorus without knowing the words. It is the best noise of your life.
outcomes.tired: You sleep through the quiet parts and wake up for the encore.

ch2_a_secret.text: {{name}} tells you a secret that is enormous. You have never been trusted with a secret this size.

ch2_swim.text: {{name}} stands in the shallow end with arms spread like a buoy. You hold the side of the pool like a rock star.

outcomes.float: You float for three whole seconds. {{name}} cheers like it is a medal race.
outcomes.sink: You sink, swallow some pool, and come up with strong feelings. {{name}} lifts you gently.

ch2_dare.text: {{name}} dares you to touch the staff room door and run. It is not even a locked door, which is the worst part.

outcomes.clean: You touch it, run, and no one sees. You are a hero for six minutes.
outcomes.busted: The teacher opens the door as you touch it. Both of you apologize.

ch2_bedtime_story.text: {{name}} reads the bedtime story and you demand it be read again, then again. By the fifth time, the dragon has changed.

ch2_crush_friend.text: You like someone, and their best friend stands guard like a tiny, aggressive bodyguard.

outcomes.ally: The friend turns out to be hilarious. You make two new friends in one week.
outcomes.tease: Everyone teases you for a month about your crush. You survive on snacks.

ch2_stranger_game.text: A friendly stranger in an online game asks for your address and wants to move the chat somewhere private. The stranger is very friendly.

outcomes.creepy: The chat gets odd quickly. You log off, rattled and a little wiser.
outcomes.nothing: Nothing happens this time. That is not a plan.

ch2_cheat_temptation.text: During a quiz, the kid beside you has the answers written clearly on their desk. You could read them without turning your head.

outcomes.caught: The teacher notices and takes your paper. The answers on the desk were wrong anyway.

ch2_pancakes.text: {{name}} makes pancakes shaped like animals. Yours is a smooth blob and you decide it is a dog.

ch2_toy_share.text: {{name}} wants to play with your favorite toy truck. You have never shared it. You have also never seen anyone else want it.

ch2_chores_allowance.text: Your parents introduce a chore chart with a small weekly payment. You study the contract like a lawyer.

ch2_birthday_party.text: It is your birthday party. There are eleven kids, one cake, and a disagreement about the loot bags.

tn2_group_chat.text: {{name}} adds you to a group chat with forty people. By midnight there are 600 messages and you have understood none of them.

tn2_online_stranger.text: Someone you only know online has been messaging you for weeks. Now they want to meet and say not to tell anyone, which is the reddest of red flags.

outcomes.close: You change your mind at the last minute and run home. It stays with you for a while.
outcomes.safe: Nobody shows up. You promise yourself a better plan.

tn2_retainer.text: The braces are finally off. Your teeth are straight, and you have a retainer you are required to wear and will certainly lose.

tn2_crush_friend.text: {{name}} knows your crush and says it can be arranged. The way they say it makes you nervous.

outcomes.smooth: {{name}} orchestrates a perfectly casual meeting. You say hello in complete sentences.
outcomes.awkward: {{name}} announces your feelings through a megaphone, almost. It is mortifying.

tn2_varsity_tryout.text: Varsity tryouts are in two weeks. You are not the best, but you have a very confident warm-up.

outcomes.made: You make the team. The coach calls you 'reliable', the nicest word in sports.
outcomes.benched: You make the squad but sit the bench. The bench is very comfortable.

tn2_diner_disaster.text: Your first job is at a small diner. By hour three you have dropped a tray, called a customer 'sir' who was not a sir, and put salt in the coffee.

outcomes.keep: The owner laughs and keeps you. You earn your first real paycheck.
outcomes.fired: You are let go on the spot with a pat on the shoulder.

tn2_prom.text: Prom is coming. You have a ticket, an outfit that almost fits, and a terrifying number of choices.

outcomes.yes: They say yes right away. The night includes slow dancing and fast spilling.
outcomes.no: They already have plans. You attend in a group, which is also fine.

tn2_cook_dinner.text: {{name}} lets you cook dinner for the whole family. It is the first meal you have planned that has more than one ingredient.

outcomes.triumph: The meal is delicious. {{name}} asks for the recipe and a second helping.
outcomes.burnt: The smoke alarm sings. You order pizza and everyone calls it a draw.

tn2_sibling_room.text: {{name}} has taken over your half of the room, one sock at a time. There is now a border that is mostly an argument.

tn2_relative_advice.text: An elderly relative takes you aside and offers life advice that sounds like a proverb and a threat. It is oddly useful.

tn2_camp_counselor.text: The camp invites you back as a junior counselor. Now you are the one holding the clipboard and the whistle.

outcomes.great: Eight weeks of songs, sunburn, and a small paycheck. You love it more than you will admit.
outcomes.chaos: Your cabin of campers stages a mutiny involving frogs. You survive on lemonade.

tn2_scout_rank.text: Your troop leader asks whether you want to lead the next camping trip. It involves tents and responsibility, in that order.

outcomes.good: Everyone comes back with the same number of limbs they started with. You are awarded a badge.
outcomes.wet: It rains for three days. You build character and a slightly damp shelter.

tn2_bully_ally.text: Your old bully-turned-friend spots someone else being picked on and looks at you. You both know the old role is available.

tn2_orchestra.text: The school orchestra needs another player. The conductor looks at you as if you are the last door in a hallway.

outcomes.shine: Your solo lasts four notes and nobody breathes during them. You leave glowing.
outcomes.blend: You blend in perfectly. That is the whole job, and you are proud.

tn2_lifeguard.text: The community pool needs a lifeguard, and you can swim. The pay is decent and the chair is very high.

outcomes.hired: You are hired. You blow the whistle at someone running for the first time and feel powerful.
outcomes.waitlist: The spots are taken. You are on a waiting list and a very good tan.

tn2_fake_sick_exam.text: A history exam is tomorrow. You have a sore throat that arrived exactly twelve hours after you started worrying.

outcomes.works: You get a makeup date. You also get a lecture on time management.
outcomes.busted: The school nurse takes your temperature and finds only guilt.

tn2_report_card_teen.text: The report card arrives. {{name}} reads it twice and says 'interesting' in a tone that could freeze a lake.

choices.own: Own it and plan to improve

tn2_concert_friends.text: {{name}} wants to go to a concert across town. It is on a school night and the line is already round the block.

outcomes.epic: The band opens with your favorite song. You scream until tomorrow's voice is gone.
outcomes.late: The concert is great, the bus home is not. You arrive at one in the morning.

tn2_curfew.text: {{name}} sets a curfew of ten. Your friends have a curfew of 'whenever'. The math is not in your favor.

outcomes.clear: You make it past the front door like a shadow. The cat sees you and says nothing.
outcomes.busted: The porch light comes on. {{name}} is standing in it, holding a cup of tea.

tn2_keep_secret.text: {{name}} tells you something serious in confidence, and asks you not to tell anyone. It is a heavy thing to carry around.

choices.adult: Encourage them to tell an adult

tn2_dare_prank.text: {{name}} dares you to hide a rubber duck in every classroom in the school. It is a very dumb idea with great structure.

outcomes.legend: By lunch the entire school is quacking. You are a mysterious legend.
outcomes.detention: The principal collects eleven ducks and a confession. You get a week of detention.

tn2_exam_cheat.text: Final exams: a classmate offers you a leaked answer sheet for ten dollars. It looks professionally printed, which is the worst part.

outcomes.pass: The answers are correct. So is your guilt.
outcomes.caught: The sheet was a trap set by the school. You are called to the office.

tn2_college_stress.text: College applications are due. You have written three essays about yourself and are tired of all three.

outcomes.great: The essays come together. You submit with ten minutes to spare and no eyesight.
outcomes.rushed: You write the last essay at 3 a.m. It is fine, and so is your headache.

tn2_talent_teen.text: The school talent show returns, and your friends sign you up without asking. You have until Friday to become talented.

outcomes.wow: You perform an impressive solo and the gym goes wild.
outcomes.meh: The mic stops working halfway through. You finish in a loud whisper.

tn2_yearbook.text: In the yearbook photo you are mid-blink. Everyone else looks wonderful and someone has written 'never change' next to you.

tn2_movie_night.text: {{name}} hosts a movie night. The film is a horror movie and everyone keeps checking whether you are scared.

tn2_lab_fire.text: During chemistry class, your burner makes a small flame. The teacher says 'that is not a small flame' and moves quickly.

outcomes.hero: The teacher extinguishes it and thanks you for not panicking. You get a gold star.
outcomes.smoke: The smoke is dramatic and the class gets evacuated. You are not blamed.

tn2_parent_embarrass.text: {{name}} waves at you from the school gate and calls out your childhood nickname. At least forty people hear it.

tn2_lost_city.text: You get on the wrong train and end up in an unfamiliar part of town. Your phone says three percent battery.

outcomes.help: The worker points you to the right platform and lends you a charger.
outcomes.slow: It takes two hours, three trains and a crisp lesson in reading maps.

tn2_ghosted.text: {{name}} stops replying to your messages. You can see they were online a minute ago. You are carefully not checking.

tn2_volunteer.text: A weekend shelter needs volunteers. The work is dishes, soup, and a lot of listening.

tn2_allowance.text: You make a case to {{name}} for a higher allowance. You bring a chart. It is a pie chart, and it is mostly pie.

outcomes.yes: {{name}} agrees on a trial basis, impressed by the chart.
outcomes.no: {{name}} says no, kindly, and keeps the chart.

tn2_college_tour.text: {{name}} takes you on a college tour. The guide walks backward and is very proud of the library.

tn2_all_nighter_game.text: A new game comes out at midnight, and the first sunrise finds you still playing. It is a school day.

tn2_friend_moves.text: {{name}} says the family is moving across the country in a month. You nod and keep walking, and then stop.
